name: GROUP_CROSSFIT
split: Sort8 H group IDs by SHA256 of fixed salt and group, assign round-robin4 folds; whole groups only; no target-based balancing
hypothesis: A corrector trained on in-sample supervised context outputs may learn an unrealistic error distribution; evaluate group-out-of-fold physical phases
normalization: Rebuild from sealed raw unique observations; fold mean/std fitted only on unique observation IDs in training-group histories, then transform train and held-out histories; prove disjoint IDs
models: Native E_CTX/R_CTX architecture and temporal training_loss with native cost term, native AdamW schedule2500, batch128, seed7; frozen P producers and PAIR unchanged
mass: Original H query masses restricted to training groups and globally normalized once; never batch renormalization
readout: Same1955-parameter PhaseOnlyAnchor on concatenated out-of-fold physical phases/clocks, zero all hidden state coordinates to forbid cross-fold latent mixing; native RGB width logits out-of-fold
deployment: Unchanged full-H V13 contexts and normalizers at V/external inference; no swapping parents inside historical F_TRUE
supervision: Only H labels for fold contexts and final corrector; supervised predictions out-of-fold by group, producers/PAIR already P-only; no claims of independent teacher
gates: Original2% and paired4000 group bootstrap. Compare existing PHASE_ONLY pair as in-sample-feature reference. All exposed development; no official SOTA.
resources: Shared admission and1GiB GPU allocation for context fits; serial own fits;18h/1M total budgets preserved
external_exposure: Prior recipe transfer is known; no external target use in folds,normalizers,training,weight selection or stopping; not a new blind holdout
validation: Exposed V development; original gates; no external selection
